The clearest underfollowed angle in this pass is Centrus as a narrow nuclear fuel / HALEU supplier, while Constellation, GE Vernova, and Quanta serve as obvious public anchors for power supply and grid buildout tied to AI data-center demand. This Layer 1B pass expands the node toward scarce, regulated, or capacity-constrained suppliers beneath AI data-center power demand. The strongest underfollowed lane is not hyperscalers or large utilities, but: HALEU/nuclear fuel-cycle capacity, medium-voltage electrical distribution equipment, transmission/substation construction, and data-center electrical/communications infrastructure contractors.
